question: Which department launched the Sanchar Mitra Scheme?
solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Department of Telecommunications (DoT)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• DoT Expands Sanchar Mitra Scheme for Digital Literacy Nationwide.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
The **Sanchar Mitra Scheme** is now a **nationwide programme**.

 
 
• 
 
Launched by the **Department of Telecommunications (DoT)** under the **Ministry of Communications**.

 
 
• 
 
It is a **volunteer-based digital outreach** initiative.

 
 
• 
 
**University students** act as "**Sanchar Mitras**".

 
 
• 
 
Focus areas: **telecom safety**, **cyber fraud prevention**, and **digital responsibility**.

 
 
• 
 
Aims to **promote digital literacy** and **cyber hygiene**.

 
 
• 
 
Bridges the gap between **citizens** and **government telecom services**.

 
 
• 
 
**Empowers youth** to be **telecom ambassadors** in their communities.
